newsitem.title: UK: Hungary to launch benchmark bond mid-year - NBH.
newsitem.headline: Hungary to launch benchmark bond mid-year - NBH.

text.p: Hungary will launch a benchmark bond in international markets in the middle of the year, the National Bank of Hungary's deputy president told Reuters.
"We expect to launch a benchmark bond mid-year," Gyorgy Szapary said. "It all depends on the markets (at the time) which currency we launch in."
Szapary said expectations of further U.S. interest rate rises meant it was not an ideal time to launch a bond as the uncertainty meant higher spreads.
Szapary said Hungary "did not need to borrow the money but we would like to stay in the market.

Hungary was last in the market with a 50 billion yen Samurai bond in early March. It was expected to launch a $500 million global bond via Deutsche Morgan Grenfell last year but opted for a syndicated loan instead.
